name: sam-store
description: SAM STORE — multi-tenant Messenger commerce platform

scripts.dev:web: cd apps/web && NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:4100 npx next dev -p 3000
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test apps/api/src/domain/*.test.ts apps/api/src/checkout/*.test.ts apps/api/src/cart/*.test.ts apps/api/src/auth/*.test.ts apps/api/src/messenger/*.test.ts apps/api/src/notifications/*.test.ts apps/api/src/admin/*.test.ts apps/api/src/pos/*.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
